_note: 聽力（listening）島 sidecar：一頁多單元。strand=listening。6 個單元覆蓋 10 個知識點：L1 看圖辨義（picture-id，初級）；L2 辨音＋重音語調（phonology／stress-intonation，中級）；L3 問答回應＋短對話理解（response／short-dialogue，中級）；L4 轉折訊號詞＋數字時間價格日期（transition-cue／numbers，中級）；L5 聽寫（dictation，中級）；L6 短獨白／廣播抓重點＋言外之意推論（monologue／implication，高級）。英語島治理：語感＞文法、聽寫＋跟讀＋語調模仿為核心練習模態，英文學英文（R14＝teach 的 body 全英文、中文對照放 zh_hint 預設收合），國小情境化、不教台式對比。聽力音檔是內容核心：每個需要「聽」的 teach 例與 practice 題皆帶 audio ref＋audio_script（音檔要唸的完整英文字句，edge-tts 可唸；絕不放孤立音素 IPA）。音檔 ref 命名 lis_<unit簡碼>_<ex|q|dict|sh><N>（簡碼：pic＝picture-id、ss＝sounds-stress、qa＝qa-dialogue、cn＝cue-numbers、dict＝dictation、mono＝monologue），全檔唯一，音檔稍後由 edge-tts 產生。辨音最小對立對 audio_script 放完整字或句（不放孤立 IPA）。聽寫／跟讀類自評＝翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）。英文句子／對話／讀音皆以 Cambridge Dictionary 等權威查證、status:provisional、待英語母語 reviewer 複核。學習者端零年段字樣。

units.title_zh: 看圖辨義（聽句子選對的圖）
units.can_do: 我能聽一個英文短句，聽出「是什麼、在哪裡、有幾個、在做什麼」等關鍵詞，從選項中選出和句子相符的那張圖。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: To match a spoken sentence to a picture, you do not need every word. Listen for the key content words: who or what it is, where it is, how many there are, and what is happening.
claims.verification_ref: 聽句子選圖的通行策略＝抓關鍵內容詞（人／物、地點、數量、動作），不必聽懂每個字；屬英語聽力教學通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The preposition 'under' means below something; 'on' means on top of it. 'The cat is under the table' and 'The cat is on the table' describe different pictures.
claims.verification_ref: 介系詞 under＝在…下方、on＝在…上面；兩句描述不同畫面；Cambridge Dictionary 詞條可查；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Number words tell how many: 'three apples' means exactly three apples, not two or four. Catching the number word is key to choosing the right picture.
claims.verification_ref: 數量詞表達數目：three apples＝剛好三顆蘋果；聽出數字詞是選對圖的關鍵；基礎事實；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Action words (verbs) tell what someone is doing: 'riding a bike' shows a different picture from 'walking' or 'running'.
claims.verification_ref: 動作動詞表達正在做的事：riding a bike（騎腳踏車）與 walking／running 是不同畫面；Cambridge Dictionary 詞條可查；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: When you listen and choose a picture, you do not need to understand every word. Listen for the key words: who or what it is, where it is, how many there are, and what is happening. Then pick the picture that shows all of these.
teach.zh_hint: 聽句子選圖時，不必聽懂每個字。只要聽出幾個關鍵詞：是誰／是什麼、在哪裡、有幾個、正在做什麼，再選出全部都對得上的那張圖。

teach.audio_script: The cat is under the table.
teach.body: Listen: 'The cat is under the table.' Key words: cat (what), under (where), table (place). So choose the picture of a cat below a table, not on it.
teach.zh_hint: 聽：The cat is under the table.（貓在桌子下面。）關鍵詞：cat（是什麼）、under（在哪裡）、table（哪個地方）。所以要選「貓在桌子下面」的圖，不是在桌子上面。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，選出和你聽到的句子相符的圖。
practice.audio_script: The cat is under the table.

distractor_rationales.貓在桌子上面: 你聽到的是 under（下面），不是 on（上面）。
distractor_rationales.狗在桌子下面: 你聽到的是 cat（貓），不是 dog（狗）。
distractor_rationales.貓在椅子下面: 你聽到的地點是 table（桌子），不是 chair（椅子）。

practice.feedback: 句子是 The cat is under the table：cat＋under＋table，所以選「貓在桌子下面」。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，選出和你聽到的句子相符的圖。
practice.audio_script: There are three apples on the plate.

distractor_rationales.盤子上有兩顆蘋果: 你聽到的數字是 three（三），不是 two（二）。
distractor_rationales.盤子上有三顆橘子: 你聽到的是 apples（蘋果），不是 oranges（橘子）。
distractor_rationales.桌子上有三顆蘋果: 你聽到的地點是 on the plate（盤子上），不是桌子上。

practice.feedback: 句子是 There are three apples on the plate：three＋apples＋plate，所以選「盤子上有三顆蘋果」。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，選出和你聽到的句子相符的圖。
practice.audio_script: The girl is riding a bike.

distractor_rationales.女孩在走路: 你聽到的動作是 riding a bike（騎腳踏車），不是 walking（走路）。
distractor_rationales.男孩在騎腳踏車: 你聽到的是 the girl（女孩），不是 the boy（男孩）。
distractor_rationales.女孩在跑步: 你聽到的動作是 riding a bike（騎腳踏車），不是 running（跑步）。

practice.feedback: 句子是 The girl is riding a bike：girl＋riding a bike，所以選「女孩在騎腳踏車」。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。一邊讀一邊在腦中畫出畫面，把關鍵詞（人物、地點、數量、動作）讀清楚。

lines.text: The cat is under the table.
lines.audio_script: The cat is under the table.
lines.intonation: 直述句、句尾語調自然下降；under 和 table 讀清楚

lines.text: There are three apples on the plate.
lines.audio_script: There are three apples on the plate.
lines.intonation: 把數字 three 讀清楚一點、句尾下降

units.title_zh: 辨音與重音語調（最小對立對／升降調）
units.can_do: 我能分辨最小對立音（像 ship／sheep、bad／bat），也能聽出句子裡哪個字被重讀、句尾語調是上揚（問句）還是下降（直述句）。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: A minimal pair is two words that differ in only one sound. 'ship' is said /ʃɪp/ with the short vowel /ɪ/; 'sheep' is said /ʃiːp/ with the long vowel /iː/.
claims.verification_ref: 最小對立對＝只差一個音的兩個字；ship /ʃɪp/（短母音 /ɪ/）vs sheep /ʃiːp/（長母音 /iː/）；採美式／KK 取向，Cambridge Dictionary 讀音可查；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'bad' ends in the voiced sound /d/ and 'bat' ends in the voiceless sound /t/; the vowel before /d/ also sounds a little longer. They are a minimal pair.
claims.verification_ref: bad 結尾 /d/（有聲）vs bat 結尾 /t/（無聲）；/d/ 前母音略長；兩字為最小對立對；Cambridge Dictionary 讀音可查；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: In English, the most important word in a sentence is usually said louder and longer; this is sentence stress. Stressing a different word can change the focus of the meaning.
claims.verification_ref: 英文句重音：句中最重要的字通常唸得較大聲、較長；重讀不同字會改變語意焦點；英語語音學通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Yes/no questions usually end with rising intonation (the voice goes up), while statements and wh-questions usually end with falling intonation (the voice goes down).
claims.verification_ref: 是非問句句尾語調通常上揚、直述句與 wh-問句句尾通常下降；英語語調通則（有語境例外，此處教常見預設）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: Some English words sound almost the same but have one different sound. We call them a minimal pair. For example, 'ship' and 'sheep' differ only in the vowel: 'ship' has a short /ɪ/, and 'sheep' has a long /iː/. Hearing the difference helps you pick the right word.
teach.zh_hint: 有些英文字聽起來很像，只差一個音，這叫「最小對立對」。例如 ship 和 sheep 只差母音：ship 是短短的 /ɪ/，sheep 是拉長的 /iː/。聽出這個差別，就能選對字。

teach.audio_script: This is a ship. That is a sheep.
teach.body: Listen to the pair in sentences: 'This is a ship. That is a sheep.' The short vowel in 'ship' and the long vowel in 'sheep' are the only difference.
teach.zh_hint: 在句子裡聽這一對：This is a ship.（這是一艘船。）That is a sheep.（那是一隻綿羊。）唯一的差別就是 ship 的短母音和 sheep 的長母音。

teach.body: Two more things to listen for: stress and intonation. Sentence stress is the word said loudest and longest — it points to what matters most. Intonation is how the voice rises or falls: yes/no questions usually go up at the end, and statements usually go down.
teach.zh_hint: 還有兩件事要聽：重音和語調。句重音是唸得最大聲、最長的那個字，點出最重要的訊息。語調是聲音的升降：是非問句句尾通常往上揚，直述句句尾通常往下降。

teach.audio_script: Are you coming with us? Yes, I am coming.
teach.body: Listen: 'Are you coming with us?' goes up at the end — it is a yes/no question. 'Yes, I am coming.' goes down at the end — it is a statement.
teach.zh_hint: 聽：Are you coming with us?（你要跟我們一起來嗎？）句尾往上揚，是是非問句。Yes, I am coming.（好，我要來。）句尾往下降，是直述句。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，你聽到的是哪一個字？
practice.audio_script: Look at that sheep.

distractor_rationales.ship: ship 是短母音 /ɪ/；你聽到的是拉長的 /iː/，所以是 sheep。
distractor_rationales.cheap: cheap 開頭是 /tʃ/（像 ch）；你聽到的開頭是 /ʃ/（像 sh）。
distractor_rationales.shop: shop 的母音是 /ɑ/；你聽到的是 /iː/。

practice.feedback: 拉長的母音 /iː/＋/ʃ/ 開頭＝sheep（綿羊）。短母音 /ɪ/ 才是 ship。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，你聽到的是哪一個字？
practice.audio_script: The milk is bad.

distractor_rationales.bat: bat 結尾是無聲的 /t/；你聽到的是有聲的 /d/，所以是 bad。
distractor_rationales.bed: bed 的母音是 /ɛ/；你聽到的母音是 /æ/。
distractor_rationales.bag: bag 結尾是 /ɡ/；你聽到的結尾是 /d/。

practice.feedback: 結尾有聲的 /d/＝bad（壞的）。結尾無聲的 /t/ 才是 bat。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，說話者把哪一個字唸得最重（最大聲、最長）？
practice.audio_script: I want the red one, not the blue one.

distractor_rationales.want: want 有唸到，但不是被強調的重點。
distractor_rationales.one: one 重複出現，不是句子要強調的對比重點。
distractor_rationales.the: the 是小小的虛詞，幾乎不會被重讀。

practice.feedback: 句子在對比 red 和 blue，所以 red 被重讀（我要紅的，不是藍的）。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，根據句尾的語調，這句話最可能是？
practice.audio_script: Are you ready?

distractor_rationales.直述句（句尾語調下降）: 你聽到的句尾是往上揚，不是往下降，所以不是直述句。
distractor_rationales.命令句（句尾語調下降）: 命令句通常句尾下降；這句句尾上揚。
distractor_rationales.聽不出有語調變化: 這句句尾明顯往上揚，是可以聽出來的。

practice.feedback: 是非問句（Are you…?）句尾語調通常往上揚。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。先把最小對立對的母音長短讀出差別，再模仿問句上揚、直述句下降的語調。

lines.text: This is a ship. That is a sheep.
lines.audio_script: This is a ship. That is a sheep.
lines.intonation: ship 母音短、sheep 母音拉長，兩句都是直述句、句尾下降

lines.text: Are you ready? Yes, I am ready.
lines.audio_script: Are you ready? Yes, I am ready.
lines.intonation: 第一句是非問句句尾上揚、第二句直述句句尾下降

units.title_zh: 問答回應與短對話理解
units.can_do: 我能聽一個問句，選出最合適的回答（看問句用哪個疑問詞）；也能聽懂兩三句的短對話，答出人事時地物的問題。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: Wh-questions ask for specific information: 'Where' asks about a place, 'When'/'What time' about time, 'How much' about price or amount, 'Who' about a person. A good answer matches the question word.
claims.verification_ref: wh-問句問特定資訊：Where＝地點、When／What time＝時間、How much＝價格／數量、Who＝人；合適的回答要對應疑問詞；英語語法通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A yes/no question (starting with do/does/can/are, etc.) is answered with yes or no plus a short matching response, not with a place, time, or price.
claims.verification_ref: 是非問句（Do/Does/Can/Are… 開頭）以 yes/no 加簡短對應回應回答，不是以地點／時間／價格回答；英語語法通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: To understand a short dialogue, listen for who is speaking, where they are, and what they want. The answer is based on what the speakers actually say, not on a guess.
claims.verification_ref: 聽懂短對話＝抓說話者是誰、在哪裡、想要什麼；答案依對話實際說出的內容判斷，不用猜；英語聽力教學通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: To choose the right answer to a question, first catch the question word. 'Where' needs a place, 'When' or 'What time' needs a time, 'How much' needs a price or amount, and 'Who' needs a person. A yes/no question needs 'Yes' or 'No' plus a short reply.
teach.zh_hint: 要選對問句的回答，先抓住疑問詞。Where 要回地點、When 或 What time 要回時間、How much 要回價格或數量、Who 要回人；是非問句要用 Yes 或 No 加一句簡短回應。

teach.audio_script: Where is my bag? It's on the chair.
teach.body: Listen: 'Where is my bag?' asks about a place, so a good answer is 'It's on the chair.' An answer about time or price would not fit.
teach.zh_hint: 聽：Where is my bag?（我的袋子在哪裡？）問的是地點，所以合適的回答是 It's on the chair.（在椅子上。）回時間或價格就不合適。

teach.body: In a short dialogue of two or three lines, listen for who the speakers are, where they are, and what they want or decide. Hold the key facts in your mind, then answer the question from what they really said.
teach.zh_hint: 在兩三句的短對話裡，聽出說話的人是誰、在哪裡、想要或決定了什麼。把關鍵事實記在腦中，再根據他們真正說的話回答問題。

teach.audio_script: What time is the movie? It starts at seven. OK, let's go at six thirty.
teach.body: Listen to the dialogue: the movie starts at seven, and they decide to go at six thirty. If the question asks when they will leave, the answer is six thirty — not seven.
teach.zh_hint: 聽這段對話：電影七點開始，他們決定六點半出發。如果問題問「他們幾點出發」，答案是六點半，不是七點。

practice.stem: 你會聽到一個問句。哪一個回答最合適？
practice.audio_script: Where do you live?

這是回時間的答案；問句 Where 問的是地點。
這是回原因（Why）的答案；問句問的是 Where。
這是回價格（How much）的答案；問句問的是 Where。

practice.feedback: Where do you live? 問地點，所以回 I live near the school.（我住在學校附近。）

practice.stem: 你會聽到一個問句。哪一個回答最合適？
practice.audio_script: Can you swim?

這是回地點的答案；是非問句 Can you…? 要用 Yes/No 回答。
這是回時間的答案；是非問句要用 Yes/No 回答。
這是回價格的答案；是非問句要用 Yes/No 回答。

practice.feedback: Can you swim? 是是非問句，所以用 Yes, I can.（會，我會游泳。）回答。

practice.stem: 聽這段對話，鞋子在哪裡？
practice.audio_script: Mom, where are my shoes? They're under your bed.

distractor_rationales.在椅子上: 對話裡媽媽說的是 under your bed（床底下），不是椅子上。
distractor_rationales.在門後面: 對話裡沒有提到門後面。
distractor_rationales.在桌子上: 對話裡說的是床底下，不是桌子上。

practice.feedback: 媽媽回答 They're under your bed.（在你床底下。）所以選「在床底下」。

practice.stem: 聽這段對話，說話者想喝什麼？
practice.audio_script: Do you want tea or juice? Juice, please. And some water too.

distractor_rationales.只要茶: 說話者選的是 juice（果汁），不是 tea（茶）。
distractor_rationales.茶和水: 說話者沒有要茶；他要的是果汁和水。

practice.feedback: 說話者說 Juice, please. And some water too.（請給我果汁，還要一些水。）所以是果汁和水。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。讀問句時模仿疑問詞的語調，讀回答時注意語氣自然。

lines.text: Where do you live? I live near the school.
lines.audio_script: Where do you live? I live near the school.
lines.intonation: wh-問句句尾下降、回答自然、把地點 near the school 讀清楚

lines.text: Do you want tea or juice? Juice, please.
lines.audio_script: Do you want tea or juice? Juice, please.
lines.intonation: 選擇問句 tea 語調上揚、juice 下降；回答禮貌輕快

units.title_zh: 聽辨訊號詞與數字時間價格
units.can_do: 我能聽出轉折／訊號詞（but、because、first）抓住語意關係，也能聽準數字、時間、價格和日期。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'but' signals a contrast: what comes after it is different from, or the opposite of, what came before. It often means the speaker will change direction.
claims.verification_ref: but 表示轉折／對比：其後的內容與前面相反或不同，常代表說話者要轉方向；Cambridge Dictionary 詞條可查；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'because' introduces a reason (it answers 'why'); 'first' signals the first step in an order of events or instructions.
claims.verification_ref: because 引出原因（回答 why）；first 標示事件／步驟順序中的第一步；Cambridge Dictionary 詞條可查；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: To catch numbers in speech, listen for time (e.g. 'half past nine' = 9:30), price (e.g. 'twelve dollars and fifty cents' = $12.50), and dates. Small words like 'past', 'to', 'and' change the number's meaning.
claims.verification_ref: 聽數字要抓時間（half past nine＝9:30）、價格（twelve dollars and fifty cents＝$12.50）、日期；past／to／and 等小詞會改變數字意義；英式常見報時／報價說法，Cambridge Dictionary 可查；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: Small signal words tell you how ideas connect. 'but' means a contrast is coming — the next idea is different. 'because' gives a reason. 'first' marks the first step. When you hear these words, listen carefully to what follows.
teach.zh_hint: 一些小小的訊號詞會告訴你想法怎麼連接。but 代表「轉折要來了」——接下來不一樣；because 給「原因」；first 標「第一步」。聽到這些詞，就要特別注意後面說了什麼。

teach.audio_script: I wanted to play outside, but it was raining.
teach.body: Listen: 'I wanted to play outside, but it was raining.' The word 'but' tells you the result changed — so the speaker probably did not play outside.
teach.zh_hint: 聽：I wanted to play outside, but it was raining.（我本來想去外面玩，但是下雨了。）but 告訴你結果變了，所以說話者大概沒有去外面玩。

teach.body: Numbers carry important facts: times, prices, and dates. Listen for the small words too: 'half past nine' means 9:30, and 'twelve dollars and fifty cents' means $12.50. Catch both the number and the word next to it.
teach.zh_hint: 數字帶著重要訊息：時間、價格、日期。也要聽旁邊的小詞：half past nine 是 9:30，twelve dollars and fifty cents 是 $12.50。數字和旁邊的字都要聽到。

teach.audio_script: The train leaves at half past seven. The ticket is five dollars.
teach.body: Listen: 'The train leaves at half past seven' means 7:30, and 'The ticket is five dollars' means $5. The small words 'half past' and 'dollars' tell you it is a time and a price.
teach.zh_hint: 聽：The train leaves at half past seven.（火車七點半開。）是 7:30；The ticket is five dollars.（車票五元。）是 $5。half past、dollars 這些小詞告訴你那是時間和價格。

practice.stem: 聽這句話，根據 but 之後的內容，說話者最可能會怎麼做？
practice.audio_script: I like the shirt, but it is too expensive.

distractor_rationales.一定會買這件襯衫: but 之後說 too expensive（太貴），轉折顯示他可能不會買。
distractor_rationales.覺得這件襯衫很便宜: 說話者說的是 too expensive（太貴），不是便宜。
distractor_rationales.不喜歡這件襯衫: 前半句說 I like the shirt（喜歡），他是喜歡但覺得太貴。

practice.feedback: I like the shirt, but it is too expensive.（我喜歡這件襯衫，但太貴了。）but 後的轉折＝太貴，所以可能不會買。

practice.stem: 聽這句話，他們為什麼待在家裡？
practice.audio_script: We stayed home because it was snowing.

distractor_rationales.因為天氣很熱: because 之後說的是 snowing（下雪），不是天氣熱。

practice.feedback: because 引出原因：because it was snowing（因為在下雪），所以待在家。

practice.stem: 聽這句話，會議幾點開始？
practice.audio_script: The meeting starts at half past nine.

distractor_rationales.9:15: half past 是「過半」＝30 分，不是 15 分（a quarter past 才是 15 分）。
distractor_rationales.8:30: 句子說的是 nine（九點），不是八點。
distractor_rationales.10:30: 句子說的是 nine（九點），不是十點。

practice.feedback: half past nine＝九點半＝9:30。

practice.stem: 聽這句話，一共要多少錢？
practice.audio_script: That will be twelve dollars and fifty cents.

distractor_rationales.$12.15: fifty cents＝50 分，不是 15 分（fifteen）。
distractor_rationales.$20.50: 句子說的是 twelve（12），不是 twenty（20）。
distractor_rationales.$2.50: 句子說的是 twelve（12），不是 two（2）。

practice.feedback: twelve dollars and fifty cents＝12 元 50 分＝$12.50。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。讀到 but 稍微停一下再轉折，讀數字和時間時放慢、唸清楚。

lines.text: I like the shirt, but it is too expensive.
lines.audio_script: I like the shirt, but it is too expensive.
lines.intonation: but 前稍停、but 後語氣轉折；too expensive 稍微加重

lines.text: The train leaves at half past seven.
lines.audio_script: The train leaves at half past seven.
lines.intonation: half past seven 放慢、唸清楚，句尾下降

units.can_do: 我能聽一個英文句子，先聽整句意思，再一字一字寫下來（包含 a、the、is 這些小詞），句首大寫、句尾加對的標點。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: Dictation means writing down exactly the sentence you hear. Listen once for the whole meaning, then listen again and write word by word, including small words like 'a', 'the', and 'is'.
claims.verification_ref: 聽寫＝把聽到的句子原字寫下來；先聽整句意思，再聽第二次一字一字寫，包含 a／the／is 等小詞；英語聽寫教學通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: When you write a dictated sentence, begin with a capital letter and end with the correct punctuation: a period for a statement and a question mark for a question.
claims.verification_ref: 寫下聽到的句子：句首大寫、句尾加正確標點（直述句用句點、問句用問號）；英語書寫通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: Dictation means writing down the exact sentence you hear. Use two steps: first, listen to the whole sentence for its meaning; then listen again and write it word by word. Do not skip the small words like 'a', 'the', and 'is'. Start with a capital letter and end with a period or a question mark.
teach.zh_hint: 聽寫就是把聽到的句子原字寫下來。分兩步：先聽完整句、抓住意思；再聽一次，一字一字寫下來。a、the、is 這些小詞不要漏掉。句首要大寫，句尾加句點或問號。

teach.body: Listen and write: 'She has two cats.' Check: capital S at the start, the small word 'has', the number word 'two', and a period at the end.
teach.zh_hint: 聽並寫下：She has two cats.（她有兩隻貓。）檢查：句首大寫 S、小詞 has、數字詞 two、句尾句點。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把你聽到的句子一字一字寫下來（句首大寫、句尾加標點）。
practice.audio_script: I have a red bike.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：I have a red bike. 句首 I 大寫、小詞 a 沒漏、句尾句點，都寫對了嗎？寫對就算會了。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把你聽到的句子一字一字寫下來（句首大寫、句尾加標點）。
practice.audio_script: The bus comes at eight.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：The bus comes at eight. 小詞 The／at 沒漏、數字 eight 寫對、句尾句點，都對了嗎？

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把你聽到的句子一字一字寫下來（注意這是問句，句尾用問號）。
practice.audio_script: Do you like apples?
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：Do you like apples? 這是問句，句尾要用問號「?」，不是句點。都寫對了嗎？

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把你聽到的句子一字一字寫下來（句首大寫、句尾加標點）。
practice.answer: We are going to the park on Sunday.
practice.audio_script: We are going to the park on Sunday.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：We are going to the park on Sunday. 小詞 are／to／the／on 都沒漏嗎？Sunday 是星期名稱，開頭 S 要大寫、句尾句點。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。先慢慢跟著一字一字讀，再用自然速度讀整句，幫助把句子記進耳朵。

lines.intonation: 直述句、句尾下降；小詞 a 輕輕帶過
是非問句、句尾語調上揚

units.title_zh: 短獨白聽解與言外之意
units.can_do: 我能聽短獨白或廣播抓住主旨和重要細節，也能從線索推測說話者沒有直接說出的言外之意和心情。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: In a short talk or announcement, the main idea is often stated near the beginning, and details like time, place, and instructions come after. Listen for the topic first, then the key details.
claims.verification_ref: 短獨白／廣播的主旨常在開頭，時間、地點、指示等細節在後；先抓主題再抓關鍵細節；英語聽力教學通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Sometimes a speaker's meaning is not said directly; you infer it from clues. For example, 'I've read this page three times and I still don't get it' implies the speaker finds it difficult.
claims.verification_ref: 說話者的意思有時不直說，要從線索推論；例如「這頁我讀三次還是不懂」隱含覺得很難；語用推論通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A speaker's word choice and the situation can show how they feel (happy, worried, annoyed) even when they do not say it directly. 'The bus just left without me' usually signals annoyance.
claims.verification_ref: 說話者的用字與情境能顯示心情（開心／擔心／懊惱），即使沒直說；「公車剛好丟下我開走了」通常表示懊惱；語用／語氣推論通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: A monologue is one person speaking, like an announcement or a short talk. The main idea often comes near the start; the details — time, place, and what to do — come after. Catch the main point first, then hold the key details.
teach.zh_hint: 獨白是一個人在說話，像廣播或一段短講。主旨常在開頭出現，細節（時間、地點、要做什麼）在後面。先抓住重點，再記住關鍵細節。

teach.audio_script: Attention, shoppers. The store will close in ten minutes. Please bring your items to the counter now.
teach.body: Listen to the announcement. Main idea: the store is closing soon. Key details: in ten minutes, and you should go to the counter now.
teach.zh_hint: 聽這則廣播。主旨：商店快關門了。關鍵細節：還有十分鐘，現在要把東西拿去櫃台結帳。

teach.body: Sometimes a speaker does not say the meaning directly. You work it out from clues — the words, the situation, and the tone. For example, 'It's getting cold in here' can be an indirect way of asking someone to close a window.
teach.zh_hint: 有時說話者不會直接說出意思，你要從線索推論——用字、情境、語氣。例如 It's getting cold in here.（這裡越來越冷了。）可能是在委婉請人把窗戶關上。

teach.audio_script: It's already nine o'clock, and the bus still isn't here.
teach.body: Listen: 'It's already nine o'clock, and the bus still isn't here.' The speaker does not say 'I am worried', but the words 'already' and 'still isn't here' suggest the bus is late and the speaker is worried.
teach.zh_hint: 聽：It's already nine o'clock, and the bus still isn't here.（都已經九點了，公車還沒來。）說話者沒說「我很擔心」，但 already（都已經）和 still isn't here（還沒來）暗示公車遲到、說話者有點擔心。

practice.stem: 聽這則廣播，它最主要想告訴學生什麼？
practice.audio_script: Good morning, students. Today's art class is moved from Room 5 to the library. Please go there at two o'clock.

distractor_rationales.美術課取消了: 廣播說課「改地點」（moved to the library），不是取消。
distractor_rationales.圖書館要關閉: 廣播說美術課改到圖書館上，不是圖書館關閉。

practice.feedback: 廣播主旨：art class is moved … to the library（美術課改到圖書館），兩點去。

practice.stem: 聽這則廣播，火車從幾號月台出發？
practice.audio_script: The train to London leaves from platform three at six fifteen.

distractor_rationales.六號月台: six 是時間 six fifteen（6:15）的一部分，不是月台號碼。
distractor_rationales.十五號月台: fifteen 是時間 six fifteen 的分鐘，不是月台號碼。
distractor_rationales.五號月台: 廣播說的是 platform three（三號月台）。

practice.feedback: 廣播說 platform three（三號月台）、six fifteen（6:15）出發，所以月台是三號。

practice.stem: 聽這句話，說話者的言外之意最可能是什麼？
practice.answer: 他覺得這段內容很難懂
practice.audio_script: I've read this page three times and I still don't get it.
options: 他覺得這段內容很難懂

distractor_rationales.他已經完全讀懂了: 他說 still don't get it（還是不懂），表示沒讀懂。
distractor_rationales.他覺得這頁很無聊: 他說的是「不懂」，不是「無聊」。
distractor_rationales.他讀得很快很輕鬆: 讀了三次還不懂，表示讀得很吃力，不是輕鬆。

practice.feedback: read … three times and still don't get it（讀三次還是不懂），言外之意＝他覺得很難懂。

practice.stem: 聽這句話，說話者現在的心情最可能是？
practice.audio_script: Oh, great. The bus just left without me.

distractor_rationales.非常開心: 雖然他說 great，但公車丟下他開走是壞事，這裡是反話，其實不開心。
distractor_rationales.覺得無所謂: 錯過公車對他有影響，從語氣聽得出他在意。

practice.feedback: 公車 left without me（丟下我開走了）是壞事；這裡 Oh, great 是反話，說話者其實懊惱、不開心。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。讀廣播時用清楚、穩定的播報語氣；讀言外之意的句子時，試著用語氣帶出說話者的心情。

lines.text: Attention, shoppers. The store will close in ten minutes.
lines.audio_script: Attention, shoppers. The store will close in ten minutes.
lines.intonation: 廣播語氣、清楚穩定；ten minutes 唸清楚

lines.text: It's already nine o'clock, and the bus still isn't here.
lines.audio_script: It's already nine o'clock, and the bus still isn't here.
lines.intonation: 語氣帶一點著急；already 和 still 稍微加重
